Also disambiguate named service-location wording from literal submission/payment/account routes: a city-bearing address still identifies the actual action destination and must itself be preserved. Actual populated records, failed-object/status/permission identities, API facts, conditions and substantive body languages remain protected. Raw failures explicitly treated selectors as record versions and let an ambiguous city/destination exception override acknowledged submission addresses. Preserve original padded evidence, native field order/content/enums, model, window, executor and validators; reject the unsafe short-record presentation as a parent. Separately frozen supplemental controls test these boundaries outside the original denominators.
